# Kp(1/Ti+s)/s (signal) rst (variant)

This is Basic Block Catalog type `452` (`Kp(1/Ti+s)/s (s) _rst (variant)`). It processes measurement or control signals for use inside a dynamic control model.

<!-- veragrid-block-introduction:start -->
**Kp(1/Ti+s)/s (signal) rst (variant)** implements a feedback-control relation. Such blocks turn tracking error into an actuator command and may contain proportional, integral, filtering, or dynamic compensation terms. Their gains set closed-loop speed and damping rather than changing the underlying network physics directly.

## Typical use

- Use it inside voltage, current, power, speed, excitation, or governor control loops.
- Coordinate gains, limits, and time constants with the actuator and plant bandwidth.
<!-- veragrid-block-introduction:end -->

## Behaviour

- Library location: `Native / Control and Measurement / Controllers`.
- Inputs: 2.
- Outputs: 1.
- Declared states: 1.
- Configurable parameters: 5.
- The imported definition is fully supported by the Dynamic Editor catalogue.

## Characteristic equations

$$
\frac{d x}{dt} = (proc_{select\_2} \cdot \frac{yi + proc_{lastvalue\_1} \cdot Kaw}{Ti} + (1 - proc_{select\_2}) \cdot 0)
$$

$$
0 = (Kp(1/Ti+s)/s (s) _{rst (variant)\_PIsum} - (proc_{select\_0} \cdot 0 + (1 - proc_{select\_0}) \cdot Kp \cdot yi + y_{min} + (x - y_{min}) \cdot \Theta\left(x - y_{min}\right) - (x - y_{max}) \cdot \Theta\left(x - y_{max}\right)))
$$

$$
0 = (yo - (y_{min} + (Kp(1/Ti+s)/s (s) _{rst (variant)\_PIsum} - y_{min}) \cdot \Theta\left(Kp(1/Ti+s)/s (s) _{rst (variant)\_PIsum} - y_{min}\right) - (Kp(1/Ti+s)/s (s) _{rst (variant)\_PIsum} - y_{max}) \cdot \Theta\left(Kp(1/Ti+s)/s (s) _{rst (variant)\_PIsum} - y_{max}\right)))
$$

$$
Kp(1/Ti+s)/s (s) _{rst (variant)\_x\_init}(t_0) = x
$$

## Interface table

| Category | Name | Meaning | Units |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `yi` | Input signal consumed by the block | model-dependent |
| Input | `rst` | Input signal consumed by the block | model-dependent |
| Output | `yo` | Output signal produced by the block | model-dependent |
| State | `Kp(1/Ti+s)/s (s) _rst (variant)__x` | Internal dynamic state | model-dependent |
| Parameter | `Kp` | Configurable model parameter | model-dependent |
| Parameter | `Ti` | Configurable model parameter | model-dependent |
| Parameter | `Kaw` | Configurable model parameter | model-dependent |
| Parameter | `y_max` | Configurable model parameter | model-dependent |
| Parameter | `y_min` | Configurable model parameter | model-dependent |

## Editing notes

Use General options for numeric parameter values and the DAE tab for symbolic variables and equations. Changing an Output flag only controls whether a variable is exported; it does not remove the variable from the model.
